purpose: Make every evidence-bound comparative system use the same definitions, time periods, geography rules, and evidence-status language before binding more systems.

definitions.rule: Domain labels and panel joins use the publication evidence panel titles and metric IDs already registered — do not invent alternate definitions per system page.

time_periods.rule: Prefer the period already published on the bound panel/critical number. If multiple periods appear, label each explicitly; never blend into a fake contemporaneous snapshot.

geography.rule: State US national vs Arkansas vs county explicitly on every Arkansas relevance claim. National dials do not become Arkansas outcomes by implication.

holds: HYP-125 through HYP-130 stay research tracks

harmonization_pass.scope: Audit the 16 bound dossiers + phase2_evidence objects for definition/period/geography/status-language consistency; fix language only — no new systems.
